results.title: How a customer requests a refund
results.content: Customers request a refund from the Orders page in the app within 30 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days (source: b-208, verified public FAQ). Other blocks (b-207, b-101, b-318) cover East China refund volume and a double-charge issue, not the request process, so they were not used for this answer.
